text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
(Everybody likes watching me race at my
current
size, and I like racing just the
way I am now too.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
(And if that's the case, there's only one
path for
me to choose.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Whoops! I mean, Taiki!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Akebono!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I might've lost today, but that there was
a
scorchin' hot race! I had a great time
out there!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My heart's still poundin' up a storm! Just
you
watch me! I'm winning the next race
for sure!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wha? Did I say somethin' funny?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
No. I was just thinking about how much
you enjoy
racing with me.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! 'Course I do! It's always so
exciting runnin'
against you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I've been obsessed with you ever since I
watched
you run in the Sprinters S.!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You'd just made your debut back then,
and I was
real excited to see what you'd
end up bringin' to
the racetrack!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And durin' that race...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono has surged to the front!
What
overwhelmingly powerful running!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Why, you left me downright
thunderstruck!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: This is so excitin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Your size and might made that race
hotter than
the sun!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And that's when it hit me that you're the
key to
everythin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If I raced against you, I'd be able to
thrill and
excite my fans and supporters
without a doubt!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I couldn't get it out of my head that I had to race with you, or else it'd be pointless!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You think so highly of me?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I see... I understand what you mean!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I've felt the same way before too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Akebono! I'll be racin' in the Mile
Ch., so
you'd better be prepared
'cause—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I know! I'm won't lose to you
either!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I return to the waiting room and wait for
Hishi
Akebono to come back. Shortly
after...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without warning, she hoists me onto her

shoulders, cutting me off halfway
through my
congratulations.
choice_data_list: おかえり！いいレースだ――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I get my bearings back, I realize
she's
brought me to the kitchen where
we did an
Umastalive stream a while
back.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm going to make chanko!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Do you know the recipe I use to make
my chanko,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've helped her make it before, but I
don't think
she's ever told me the details
of it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I suppose you wouldn't! I created my
own chanko
after a lot of trial and error
as a kid.
choice_data_list: ちゃんと聞いたことはない、かも

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I need to go buy some ingredients, but
I'll be
right back, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I still have no idea what's going on, but
it seems
that Hishi Akebono has a plan
in mind, so I
patiently wait for her return.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click-click-click... Whoosh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: To make my chanko...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You have to make sweet chicken
meatballs using
miso and sugar, and
simmer them in broth to draw
out the
umami flavor.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The broth should be light and made with
kombu
seaweed, light soy sauce, sake,
mirin, and a pinch
of salt.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That's why it's so important to start
making the
meatballs as soon as you've
set the broth to boil!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After explaining this to me, Hishi
Akebono sets a
bowl full of minced
chicken in front of herself and
sets to
work.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mix in the miso, sugar, garlic, and
ginger, then
begin to knead the minced
meat.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Once it turns whitish, add water and
sake in little
by little and knead it some
more.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Adding water makes it easier to bring
out the
umami flavor in the meat. Don't
forget this buono
point! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Last, add in some carrots and potato
starch, and
knead it some more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The moment Hishi Akebono says that,
the pot of
broth on the stove starts
boiling.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh! Perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono starts scooping spoonfuls
of the
meatball mix and dropping them
into the broth
with a well-practiced
hand.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Okay, the meatballs are all done!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The meatballs are the most important
part of my
chanko, so I'm extra
particular about how I make
them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's always so easygoing in the kitchen,
so I had
no idea she was so particular
about this step of
the process.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right. The veggies are ready too, so
now we
just have to wait.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The gentle yet sweet aroma of the broth
begins
to waft from the pot and fills the
room.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's started simmering. It won't be
long now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, well...
choice_data_list: ……どうして突然ちゃんこ鍋を？

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Chanko makes up the heart of every
sumo stable.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Each stable has a different recipe, and
wrestlers
become very attached to their
own stable's
chanko.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard the training was that
day,
they always feel better after a big
bowl of
chanko.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It helps them do their best day after
day.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And because of that...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I think they'd be really disappointed if
the flavor
of their chanko changed.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
There's something I want to be for the
people
who come to watch me and my
friends who race
against me...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And that's a chanko that they know and
love.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I step out from the paddock,
people
cheer me on and marvel at how
big I am.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
They love my unique running style, and
smile
whenever a race is over.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And I want to keep racing for everyone
who looks
at me with such great
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Even if I can't compete as long, I want to
keep
running my way.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I want to protect the unique flavor that
only I
have.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Here you go!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Dig in, Trainer! It tastes the most buono
when it's
fresh and hot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I eat one spoonful of the chanko placed
in front
of me, then another.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The meatballs are sweet, and the broth
is clear
and refreshing. It tastes the same
as it always has,
and like I expected it to
be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It must pain Hishi Akebono a lot to think
of how
this might cut her racing career
short.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But there is something else she wants to
protect
that's more important to her. Her
determination
comes across loud and
clear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I keep her gaze and promise that we'll
make it the
best race ever.
choice_data_list: 全力で、フォローし続けるから

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best! I'll race with all my
strength!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I give Hishi Akebono an acknowledging
nod—and
suddenly get lifted off my feet
by her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Per Hishi Akebono's request, our next
race will be
the Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's where the fall Ruler of the Mile
will be
crowned.
